parsed.note_claim: Hakimi e Hiba Abouk se separaram em 2023.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The young footballer's wife, Hiba Abouk, 36, with whom he has two children, announced last month that she had been separated from the footballer for a while and was pending formal divorce proceedings.
parsed.reason: The page directly confirms the 2023 separation and also states there is no evidence that Hakimi transferred his assets to his mother's name, consistent with the note's claims.
